Description: Permanent community identifier — never changes once assigned. Assigned by data manager not field team.
QC_Rule: No duplicates; no nulls; must follow format pattern; must remain stable across all data versions

Description: Community name as used locally by residents and field team
QC_Rule: No nulls; flag duplicate name+LGA combinations for verification

Description: Project state identifier
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_States.csv; no nulls

Description: Official state name
QC_Rule: Must be consistent with State_Code; no nulls

Description: Project LGA identifier
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_LGAs.csv; must be consistent with State_Code; no nulls

Description: Official LGA name
QC_Rule: Must be consistent with LGA_Code; no nulls

Description: Community GPS latitude decimal degrees WGS84
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be within Nigeria bounds (4.0–14.0); must fall within stated state boundary

Description: Community GPS longitude decimal degrees WGS84
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be within Nigeria bounds (2.5–15.0); must fall within stated state boundary

Description: GPS horizontal accuracy in metres at time of recording
QC_Rule: No nulls; flag >30m; reject >100m — require re-survey

Description: Date community GPS point and baseline data were collected
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date; must not be future date; must be >= 2026-01-01

Description: Estimated resident population at time of survey
QC_Rule: If present must be >0; flag >50000 for verification; NULL = not recorded (not zero)

Description: Primary community livelihood code
QC_Rule: If present must resolve to LKP_Livelihood.csv; NULL permitted

Description: Electricity access status at community level
QC_Rule: Allowed values only if present; NULL permitted

Description: Primary water source code
QC_Rule: If present must resolve to LKP_WaterSource.csv

Description: Whether community members report flood experience
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; NULL permitted

Description: Whether erosion is observed or reported in the community
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; NULL permitted

Description: Distance in km to nearest hydropower facility — calculated from G07 after GIS phase; do not manually enter
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; populated by GIS script not field team

Description: Primary adaptation status code
QC_Rule: If present must resolve to LKP_AdaptationStatus.csv

Description: Reference ID of primary community photograph
QC_Rule: If present must have corresponding file in 02_Fieldwork/Photos/

Description: Field team notes — review before publication for sensitive content
QC_Rule: No QC rule; flag for editorial review before any publication

Description: Date record was entered into the database
QC_Rule: Auto-populated by system on insert; no nulls

Description: Date record was last modified
QC_Rule: Auto-populated by system on update

Description: Data version at time of record creation or last update
QC_Rule: No nulls; must follow version convention

Description: Processing status of this record
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_QC_Status.csv; default RAW on insert
